critical_code_review_comments: orders.py _build_payment references `_os.environ.get(...)` on line 282 but `import os as _os` is at line 643 — works at request time (module fully loaded before first call) but visually confusing; consider moving the alias import to the top.

members.py adjust_member: for field=='member_discount_pct' when set_value is None and delta is passed, code takes delta as absolute value (not a delta). Behavior differs from other fields; matches the frontend which sends set_value, but could confuse future callers — worth a docstring note.
Empty _os.environ.get('TERMINAL_PROVIDER','manual') branch in _build_payment: OK but no unit coverage yet.
screens.py POST /broadcasts warns but does not annotate the created doc with a `has_conflicts` flag on the persisted record — only in the response; querying later broadcasts won't know.
